name: snyk-onboard
description: Onboard a GitHub repo or a whole org to Snyk: detect each repo's tech stack, pick the Snyk products that fit (Open Source, Code, Container, IaC), import the repos into a Snyk org and open a PR per repo with a .snyk policy and a stack-specific GitHub Actions workflow; checks for the Snyk MCP server and asks before installing it. Plans first and writes nothing until you approve. Supports --dry-run.
